parts.text: As a dispatcher, I plan and run the flights by deciding which drone flies along which way, and I sign off each flight before it leaves. My legal responsibility includes choosing the drone and the way it flies, and I am the licensed person who can call off a flight. Several of us plan at the same time, often for the same busy sites and popular drones, and I want help finding out which of our drones could get to where a job starts.
